source.community: runs\community-saves\StellarBlade\ (gitignored): the Nexus archives as downloaded (DOWNLOADS.md there lists them; Nexus refuses scripted downloads, so the user saves them by hand), extracted\<mod id>\ their contents (data files only: an archive with an executable is refused), catalog.json the decoded state of every save (analysis\sbsave.py info). runs\save-sets\stellarblade\community\<rung>.sav is the community file byte for byte: the recipe's save_retarget writes this PC's SteamID64 into a copy under runs\save-retarget\ at run time.

target.file: StellarBladeSave00.sav (the first slot; New Game+ adds StellarBladeSave01.sav and so on)
target.backup: runs\save-backups\20261111-before-stellarblade\SaveGames (the whole folder before any ladder run, 2026-11-11 03:30)

install: run-test.ps1 -SaveFile retargets the rung (save_retarget: OnlineAccountID = the logged-in account, its two sizes and the CRC; the game refuses a save whose owner is another account) and copies it over StellarBladeSave00.sav, stamped with the current time; the file before goes to <run>\save-before\, the game's copy after to <run>\save-after\. StellarBladeSetting.sav (graphics, controls) is never replaced: a community archive's Setting file is not used.

Steam Cloud is on (steam_autocloud.vdf). The harness holds Steam offline during runs; at the next online start Steam uploads the last rung's slot. This ladder was set up on blade18 (game installed 2026-11-10); before another PC that plays Stellar Blade on mopic_demo1 runs it, expect Steam to offer a cloud conflict for the slot (keep the local file).
Achievements: a NG+ or 100 % save can unlock achievements on mopic_demo1 when loaded (aram accepted that on 2026-11-11). They sync when Steam goes online again.

Run it with -Dll of a UEVR that has PR #28 (c1ecaa87 on; blade18: runs\dlls\uevr-c1ecaa87\UEVRBackend.dll) until a release has it: with the release v1.0.5.5 the game's UI never reaches the Mopic display and every rung fails at the title. Put the release DLL back afterwards.

The save says where the player is: DataMap_FString MapName (G03 = the prologue beach), CampAlias (the last camp), DataMap_int32 PlayTime (s), NewGamePlusPlayCount, GameDifficulty, TrackingQuestAliases (the tracked story quest). sbsave.py info prints them; each rung copies them.

The recipe loads the first card of 불러오기 and does not check it is the rung's save. That holds while StellarBladeSave00.sav is the only slot (blade18, 2026-11-11). If a PC has more slots (an NG+ play-through adds StellarBladeSave01.sav and so on), check before a run which card comes first: the game may sort by the date inside the save, not by the file time the harness sets. Otherwise a run can load another slot and still PASS.

pending_community lists the Nexus saves to add, in story order, with the place their pages give. Saves made at a camp load at that camp (safe, no enemy in view); a save 'right before a boss' may load inside a fight or a cut scene, where the recipe's movement keys do little and the pause menu may still work (cut scenes: Esc skips or pauses).
